verse_text: Controlling all of them, one should remain concentrated on Me as the supreme. For, the wisdom of one whose organs are under control becomes steadfast.

sentence: Finding a quiet space and maintaining a focused, devoted mindset can also support this sense of balance [13.11].
verse_text: And unwavering devotion to Me with single-minded concentration; inclination to repair into a clean place; lack of delight in a crowd of people;

sentence: It can be helpful to approach this situation by practicing forgiveness, gentleness, and freedom from anger [16.2].

sentence: You might consider letting go of your personal attachments and aversions regarding the conflict [18.51].

sentence: The Gita suggests that you can engage in your daily life while maintaining an equanimous mind, regardless of whether you feel happiness or sorrow about the outcome [2.38].
verse_text: Treating happiness and sorrow, gain and loss, and conest and defeat with eanimity, then engage in battle. Thus you will not incur sin.

sentence: It is also suggested that you could try to act without focusing on personal expectations or ego [3.30].
verse_text: Devoid of the fever of the soul, engage in battle by dedicating all actions to Me, with (your) mind intent on the Self, and becoming free from expectations and egoism.

sentence: Practicing this kind of inner balance with a steady and undismayed heart is described as a way to find freedom from misery [6.23].
verse_text: One should know that severance of contact with sorrow to be what is called Yoga. That Yoga has to be practised with perservance and with an undepressed heart.

sentence: These steps offer a way to navigate your feelings while remaining true to your own character [16.2].

sentence: It is natural to experience feelings of attachment or aversion toward the people around us, but these reactions can sometimes act as obstacles to our own inner peace [3.34].
verse_text: Attraction and repulsion are ordained with regard to the objects of all the organs. One should not come under the sway of these two, because they are his adversaries.

sentence: When we dwell on our interactions with others, we may find that attachment leads to longing, which can eventually turn into anger [2.62].
verse_text: -2.63 In the case of a person who dwells on objects, there arises attachment for them. From attachment grows hankering, from hankering springs anger.

sentence: The Gita suggests that one might find more stability by remaining balanced, whether facing friends or those who cause us distress [12.18].

verse_text: Of him, by whom has been conered his very self by the self, his self is the friend of his self. But, for one who has not conered his self, his self itself acts inimically like an enemy.

sentence: By working to conquer the mind, we can transform it into our own best friend [6.6].

sentence: Ultimately, we are encouraged to remain steady regardless of the honor or dishonor we receive from others [12.18].

verse_text: But even these actions have to be undertaken by renouncing attachment and (hankering for) results. This is My firm and best conclusion, O Parhta.

sentence: The Gita suggests that you might find balance by remaining equipoised, whether you experience success or failure in your efforts [2.48].
verse_text: By being established in Yoga, O Dhananjaya (Arjuna), undertake actions, casting off attachment and remaining eipoised in success and failure. Eanimity is called Yoga.

sentence: You could consider practicing a sense of non-attachment toward your family members and home, while maintaining an even mind regardless of whether events turn out as you desired or not [13.10].
verse_text: Non-attachment and absence of fondness with regard to sons, wives, homes, etc., and constant eanimity of the mind with regard to the attainment of the desirable and the undesirable;

sentence: Another perspective offered is to perform your actions as a sacrifice, focusing on your duties rather than on personal gain [3.9].
verse_text: This man becomes bound by actions other than that action meant for God. Without being attached, O son of Kunti, you perform actions for Him.

sentence: You might also find it supportive to keep your mind fixed on the Divine and offer your devotion through your daily actions [18.65].
verse_text: Have your mind fixed on Me, be My devotee, be a sacrificer to Me and bow down to Me. (Thus) you will come to Me alone. (This) truth do I pormise to you. (For) you are dear to Me.

sentence: By shifting your focus in these ways, you may find a way to care for your family while maintaining your own inner stability [2.48].
